items.t: Prediction: Oklo Stock Could Have a Huge Year as Nuclear Energy Demand Accelerates
items.sum: Oklo has lost most of its value this year, yet it sits on billions in cash and a reactor already taking shape in Idaho. Why one model still sees a discount hiding in the wreckage.

items.t: Oklo and NuScale Power Retreat 8% as AI Power Selloff Deepens; Energy Fuels Drops 6%
items.sum: Nuclear stocks that rode the AI power boom are now bleeding, and hot inflation and fresh tariffs are only part of the story. Why do three nuclear names fall by different amounts when the same selloff hits them?

items.t: OKLO Has More Cash, But Is NuScale the Better Nuclear Stock?
items.sum: OKLO and SMR are targeting the growing power needs of data centers, but their contrasting business models could shape how and when they generate revenues.

items.t: Oklo Sinks 14% in a Week, NuScale Down 19%, as the AI Selloff Hits Nuclear Stocks. Time to Buy?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOklo fell 14% in a week with no bad news of its own, as the AI selloff hit NuScale Power and Bloom Energy too. Oklo’s own news was good: a test reactor was cleared, and it signed definitive fuel contracts with Centrus Energy.

items.t: 1 Reason I Haven’t Bought Oklo Stock -- and Probably Never Will
items.sum: Oklo still faces a cash flow dilemma.

items.t: Groves 1 Approval Could Open NASA Opportunity For Oklo Stock
items.sum: Oklo reported that the U.S. Department of Energy cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves-1 test reactor, allowing full research, testing, and training activities that support future isotope production and the Aurora fast fission reactors.
